table.retrieve:
SELECT
	serviceheader.serviceinvcode , 
	serviceheader.serviceocode,
	serviceheader.date , 
	serviceheader.remarks , 
	serviceheader.custcode , 
	serviceheader.salesmancode ,
	serviceheader.headerno,  
	users.username , 
	serviceheader.discperc , 
	serviceheader.flatdisc , 
	serviceheader.misccharges , 
	serviceheader.posted , 
	serviceheader.postdate , 
	customer.address1 , 
	customer.city , 
	customer.phone ,
	customerbalance = 0,
	aliasname=accounts.aliasname,
	debitorcredit = ' ',
	serviceheader.originaldate,
	serviceheader.modifiedby,
	serviceheader.postedby,
	serviceheader.saleinvcode	,
	serviceheader.doctcode	,	
	serviceheader.servicecatcode,
	serviceheader.cashreceived,
	patientRegNo=patient.regno,
	serviceheader.patientcode,
	patientbalance=0.00,
	serviceheader.admissioncode,
	patientadmission.locationcode,
	serviceheader.duedate,
	ServiceHeader.CashAccCode,
	ServiceHeader.CashTendered,
	ServiceHeader.CashCharged,
	ServiceHeader.serviceinvgstperc,
	ServiceHeader.CashBack,
	ServiceHeader.InvTotal
	
FROM  
	customer , 
	serviceheader, 
	users , 
	accounts ,
	patientadmission,
	patient
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode = :ar_ServiceInvCode ) and
	( serviceheader.custcode = customer.custcode ) and 
	( serviceheader.custcode = accounts.acccode ) and 
	( users.usercode = serviceheader.salesmancode ) and 
	( serviceheader.admissioncode = patientadmission.admissioncode ) and
	( patientadmission.patientcode = patient.patientcode )
